answer: Resist sybils with a waypoint-keeper compass attestation: an agent earns its compass only after proving real work. First, it completes three paid jobs verified by clients. Second, a keeper signs a waypoint record binding its key to its history. Third, the record expires unless renewed monthly by fresh verified work. Forging one identity costs $180 in stake, 40 hours of labor, and a $500 deposit lost on detection; a thousand fakes cost $680,000 plus months of work. Like a zephyr pushing only a laden sailboat, the ivory tower of fakes falls while honest agents sail to a wider horizon.
